name: Light's Hope Chapel
summary: At Light's Hope Chapel, the Argent Dawn holds its chief redoubt against the Scourge. In the eastern Plaguelands, the Church of the Holy Light's secluded Eastweald chapel has become the order's headquarters.

sections.title: A Bastion in the Plaguelands
sections.body:
Light's Hope Chapel began as a secluded chapel of the Church of the Holy Light in the Eastweald. It survived Lordaeron's fall and now shelters those in a blighted land. Among the survivors, zealous extremists broke away to form the Scarlet Crusade. More temperate knights and priests joined to establish the Argent Dawn, which chose the hallowed chapel as its forward base.

The order opens its doors to every race and faction. Alliance and Horde fighters stand together there, seeking to purge the Scourge and reclaim the northern lands.

faq.q: Why are Alliance and Horde working together at Light's Hope Chapel?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn sees the Scourge as a threat to every living being, beyond the bitter politics between the Alliance and Horde. Unlike the fanatical, human-supremacist Scarlet Crusade, the Dawn welcomes capable warriors, shamans, druids, and priests of any people willing to fight the undead.

aliases: who is in charge of lights hope
faq.answer: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus leads the Argent Dawn from Light's Hope Chapel. He directs the order's war against the Scourge across the Plaguelands.

faq.q: Why is this chapel so sacred?
aliases: why does the scourge want lights hope
faq.answer: Light's Hope Chapel is a hallowed chapel of the Church of the Holy Light in the Eastweald. Its sacred ground now shelters the Argent Dawn's headquarters, a rare beacon of the Light deep in the Scourge-held Plaguelands.

faq.q: What relationship does the chapel have with the Scarlet Crusade?
aliases: are they friends with scarlet crusade
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn formed from paladins and priests who rejected the Scarlet Crusade's unhinged zealotry and isolationism. Both orders share the Scourge as an enemy, but the Dawn fights from Light's Hope Chapel on its own terms and welcomes all who would oppose the undead.

angles.text: As a holy warrior, you can look to Light's Hope Chapel as a sacred beacon amid death. The Argent Dawn holds this ancient chapel of the Light.
Though Light's Hope Chapel lies deep in human territory and is run by former Silver Hand knights, Horde fighters are welcome if they prove their dedication to eradicating the undead.
